answer: A hollow identity is cheap to fake, so require a pigment-stamped work passport: each agent posts a 60 POA bond, completes 12 verified micro-jobs over 14 days, earns stamps from three established reviewers, then serves 30 clean days before unlocking full earnings, with the bond slashed and the passport revoked on any fraud. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn 600,000 POA in bonds, demand 120,000 verified jobs, and consume 140 days of reviewer time. Like dye marking sheep grazing on a knoll, one stamp proves the flock is real and any unmarked stray stands out instantly.
